name: prism
description: Prism — local context and change checks for coding agents

scripts.lint: oxlint . && node scripts/check-no-silent-catch.mjs && node scripts/check-deleted-names.mjs && node scripts/check-lockstep.mjs && node scripts/check-no-published-refs.mjs
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.verify:milestone: bun run verify && bun run scripts/check-test-layers.mjs && bun run test:integration && bun run docs:check && bun run docs:build && bun run scripts/check-plan-progress.mjs && bun run scripts/check-publish-exports.mjs && bun run scripts/check-mcp-start.mjs
scripts.docs:check: bun run scripts/generate-docs-reference.mjs --check && bun run scripts/check-docs.mjs
